editor.section_order_desc: Drag sections to reorder them on the overview page. Empty sections are hidden automatically.
editor.stack_order_desc: Drag blocks to set their order in this room view.
editor.theme_desc: Select a theme for all automatically generated dashboard views. Custom views with their own YAML theme keep that setting.
editor.background_image_desc: Pick an image in the media dialog or upload it directly. Alternatively use a path or URL such as /local/background.jpg.
editor.weather_entity_desc: Manually select a weather entity. If nothing is selected, the first available weather entity is used automatically.
editor.show_clock_card_desc: Shows the clock card on the overview.
editor.show_person_badges_desc: Shows the automatically generated person badges in the overview header. Disable this if you want to replace them with custom badges.
editor.person_badge_layout_desc: Controls whether person badges only show the name, include the current state, or include state and relative time.
editor.alarm_desc: Select an alarm control panel entity. When the clock card is active, the alarm panel is shown next to it. Without the clock card, the alarm panel takes the full width.
editor.house_mode_desc: Select an input_select or select helper. It is shown on the overview as a dropdown below the clock.
editor.show_search_card_desc: Shows the custom:search-card directly below the clock on the overview. When unset, it is shown automatically if its dependencies are installed.
editor.show_search_card_missing: Requires custom:search-card and card-tools. Please install both components to use this feature.
editor.search_card_tip_body: Use Home Assistant's search button in the top bar to find entities, devices, areas, automations, and settings.
editor.show_unavailable_alert_badge_desc: Adds a header badge with the count of visible entities currently unavailable.
editor.show_now_playing_badge_desc: Adds a header badge for the first visible media player that is currently playing.
editor.show_sun_badge_desc: Adds a sunrise or sunset badge for sun.sun in the overview header.
editor.show_updates_badge_desc: Adds a header badge with the count of visible update entities that have pending updates.
editor.columns_desc: Choose how summary cards should be displayed. The layout adjusts automatically when cards are hidden.
editor.group_security_by_areas_desc: Uses an area-oriented layout similar to Home Assistant's security panel.
editor.show_security_activity_desc: Adds a native logbook card when the logbook integration is available.
editor.show_light_view_desc: Generates /lights even when the light summary is hidden.
editor.group_lights_by_floors_desc: Groups lights in the lights view by floors. Each floor gets its own section with on/off buttons.
editor.group_lights_by_areas_desc: Groups lights by area, nested below floors when both options are enabled.
editor.group_covers_by_floors_desc: Groups covers in the covers view by floors. Each floor gets its own subsection with a heading. Awnings and windows remain unsplit.
editor.group_covers_by_areas_desc: Groups covers by area, nested below floors when both options are enabled.
editor.nested_light_groups_desc: Shows light groups as expandable containers with their member lights underneath. Disabled by default to preserve the existing flat list behavior.
editor.lights_sort_by_name_desc: Sorts lights by display name instead of last changed. Applies to the lights view, room views, and nested light groups.
editor.show_covers_view_desc: Generates /covers even when the cover summary is hidden.
editor.show_partially_open_covers_desc: Shows partially open covers (neither fully open nor closed) in a separate group.
editor.show_security_view_desc: Generates /security even when the security summary is hidden.
editor.hide_hidden_areas_in_security: Also hide hidden areas from security
editor.hide_hidden_areas_in_security_desc: By default security entities and cameras from overview-hidden areas remain visible. Enable this to filter them.
editor.show_climate_summary_desc: Shows the climate summary card on the overview. When unset, it is shown automatically when visible climate entities exist.
editor.show_climate_view_desc: Generates /climate even when the climate summary is hidden.
editor.show_battery_view_desc: Creates the /batteries subview even when the battery summary card is hidden on the overview.
editor.hide_mobile_app_batteries_desc: Hides batteries from smartphones, tablets, and watches (Mobile App) from the battery overview and summary.
editor.hide_battery_notes_entities_desc: Hides helper entities created by the Battery Notes integration from the battery overview and summary.
editor.show_area_in_battery_view_desc: Prefixes battery tile names in the battery view with the assigned area name.
editor.group_batteries_by_areas_desc: Groups batteries within each status by area and adds a trailing No area group.
editor.battery_thresholds_desc: Thresholds for battery status groups (Critical / Low / Good).
editor.unavailable_batteries_bucket_desc: Controls whether batteries with unavailable or non-numeric states default to the good or critical group.
editor.show_weather_desc: Shows the weather forecast card on the overview when a weather entity is available.
editor.show_weather_forecast_card_desc: Legacy compatibility switch. If disabled, the weather section defaults to no presentation unless an explicit weather presentation is selected.
editor.weather_sensors_desc: Optional sensor row above the weather card. One line per sensor in the format entity|icon|unit|round.
editor.show_energy_desc: Shows the energy distribution card on the overview when energy data is available.
editor.power_badge_entity_desc: Shows the selected entity as an extra header badge, for example current household power usage.
editor.agenda_calendar_entities_desc: Optional comma-separated list of calendar entities for the agenda section. Leave empty to auto-detect visible calendars.
editor.todos_entities_desc: Optional comma-separated list of todo entities for the todos section. Leave empty to auto-detect visible todo lists.
editor.favorites_desc: Select entities to be shown as favorites below the summaries. Entities are displayed as tiles.
editor.light_favorites_desc: Adds a dedicated quick-access section for selected lights.
editor.room_visibility_desc: Room views and navigation tabs are generated only while the configured entity has the expected state.
editor.group_by_floors_desc: Groups areas on the overview by floors. When enabled, a separate section is created for each floor.
editor.area_display_type_desc: Sets the default display for all area cards. Picture mode uses the area picture configured in Home Assistant; areas without a picture remain compact.
editor.area_display_type_no_picture: This area has no picture. Its card remains compact when picture mode is selected.
editor.show_switches_on_areas_desc: Shows switches as controls on the area cards in the overview. Home Assistant hides these by default.
editor.show_alerts_on_areas: Show alert icons on area cards
editor.show_alerts_on_areas_desc: Shows alert icons (e.g. motion, moisture, heat) on area cards when a binary sensor in the area is active.
editor.show_locks_in_rooms_desc: Shows locks (e.g. Nuki) in the respective room views. Locks always appear in the security overview regardless.
editor.show_cover_controls_in_rooms: Show batch buttons on cover headings
editor.show_cover_controls_in_rooms_desc: Shows open, stop and close buttons for suitable covers and curtains in room views.
editor.show_automations_in_rooms_desc: Shows automations assigned to the area in the respective room views.
editor.show_scripts_in_rooms_desc: Shows scripts assigned to the area in the respective room views.
editor.show_vacuums_section_in_rooms_desc: Shows vacuums and lawn mowers in their own section instead of Misc.
editor.show_switches_section_in_rooms_desc: Shows switches and smart outlets in their own room section instead of Misc.
editor.camera_live_toggle_desc: Uses the camera wrapper with a play/stop toggle. Without this option, native Home Assistant camera cards are shown.
editor.show_energy_in_rooms: Show energy block in room views
editor.show_energy_in_rooms_desc: Shows the area's power, energy, water, and gas sensors as a dedicated block in the respective room view.
editor.show_ups_in_rooms_desc: Automatically detects UPS devices and shows a block per device with battery level and related sensors in the respective room view. Sensors hidden via the 'no_dboard' label or entity options are not included.
editor.show_window_contacts_in_rooms: Show window contacts in room views
editor.show_window_contacts_in_rooms_desc: Shows window contacts as badges in the respective room views.
editor.show_door_contacts_in_rooms: Show door contacts in room views
editor.show_door_contacts_in_rooms_desc: Shows door contacts as badges in the respective room views.
editor.use_default_area_sort_desc: Uses the area sorting from Home Assistant instead of the order configured here.
editor.areas_manage_desc: Choose which areas should be shown on the dashboard and in what order. Expand areas to manage individual entities.
editor.area_entity_settings_desc: Expand an area to configure entities, ordering, cameras, and additional cards.
editor.room_pins_desc: Select entities to be shown first in their assigned rooms. Ideal for entities that are not automatically detected (e.g. weather stations, special sensors). Only entities with room assignment can be selected. These pins only appear in their respective room, not on the overview.
editor.user_visibility_warning: Display logic only: hidden views remain reachable by URL. Reload the dashboard after changes.
editor.user_visibility_no_person_warning: User accounts without a linked person cannot be selected and lose a view as soon as that view has a rule.
editor.show_summary_views_desc: Shows the summary views (Lights, Covers, Security, Batteries) in the top navigation.
editor.show_room_views_desc: Shows individual room views in the top navigation.
editor.show_cctv_view_desc: Creates an optional camera view grouped by area.
editor.cctv_show_activity_desc: Shows motion, occupancy, and doorbell activity for the last twelve hours.
editor.show_maintenance_view_desc: Shows pending updates, unavailable entities, and maintenance tips.
editor.area_view_override_intro: Manage areas or expand one to paste a complete Lovelace view as YAML.
editor.area_view_override_help: The YAML replaces the automatically generated view for this area. Title, path, and icon still come from the Home Assistant area.
editor.area_view_override_object_error: YAML must produce a complete view object
editor.hidden_section_headings_desc: Hides generated heading cards for selected overview sections while keeping their content visible.
editor.section_visibility_desc: Only show a generated overview section when the selected entity matches the configured state.
editor.hide_unavailable_entities_desc: Dynamically hides entity cards and badges whose state is 'unavailable' or 'unknown'. As soon as the entity is available again, it reappears without a reload.
editor.dense_section_placement_desc: Enables dense placement in generated sections views so gaps in the grid can be filled automatically.
editor.section_custom_content_desc: Custom cards, sections, badges, and views are managed here in one place. The start page layout can place these items directly.
editor.custom_content_weather_start_hint: Cards and sections for the weather start page are edited above in the layout order. This area only keeps content that is not placed there.
editor.custom_sections_help: Create complete sections with a custom title, icon, and any cards. Each section appears as a separate section on the overview.
editor.custom_section_yaml_invalid: The section YAML must contain a valid section or card configuration.
editor.custom_cards_desc: Heading and icon for the custom cards section on the dashboard. Leave empty for defaults.
editor.custom_cards_help: Add custom cards to the overview. Cards appear in a separate section between summaries and areas. Tip: Create the card in a regular dashboard first, copy the YAML code, and paste it here.
editor.custom_badges_help: Add custom badges to the overview header (next to person chips).
editor.custom_views_help: Create custom views with any cards. Tip: Create the view in a regular dashboard first, copy the YAML code, and paste it here.
editor.custom_views_ref_help: Referenced views are loaded live from the source dashboard on every load. Strategy dashboards cannot be referenced.
editor.ref_dashboard_missing: The referenced dashboard is missing or no longer referenceable
editor.no_entities_in_area: No entities found in this area
editor.card_editor_title_help: This name only helps with finding and sorting the card. It is not shown on the dashboard.
editor.area_custom_cards_help: Custom cards, tiles, and complete sections for this room view. Shown in addition to the automatic sections.
editor.weather_start_order_desc: Drag and drop the blocks to set their order on the weather start page. Hidden blocks are preserved.
editor.weather_start_stack_warning: Several blocks are appended to the same column. Check the resulting height on mobile devices.
editor.weather_start_responsive_warning: {count} nested grids use fixed columns. Prefer grid_options for responsive layouts.
editor.weather_start_block_yaml_desc: Enter one or more card configs as YAML. If set, replaces the auto-generated content of this block.
editor.weather_start_card_yaml_desc: Edit the card YAML, for example entity ID, name, icon, color, or other Lovelace options.
editor.weather_start_section_cards_desc: Edit the cards in this section. The section itself is placed in the layout order.
editor.weather_start_add_content_desc: Add content to the weather start page:
editor.weather_start_stack_with_previous: Show below previous block in the same column
editor.no_weather_sensors: No sensors configured. Use the picker below to add one.
editor.show_pollen_card_desc: Shows the current pollen load (today + tomorrow) below the weather card. Uses the DWD Pollenflug integration from HACS.
editor.hide_section_headings_desc: Hides individual section headings on the overview. Useful for compact mobile layouts where the headings add visual noise.
editor.show_cameras_in_security: Show cameras in the security view
editor.show_cameras_in_security_desc: Shows the cameras as compact still-image cards in the security view (like the Home Assistant security panel). When the camera view is enabled, the cameras heading links straight to it.
editor.security_cameras_visibility_desc: Unchecked cameras disappear from the security and camera views — room views are unaffected.
editor.security_activity_at_end: Move activity log to the end
editor.security_extra_entities_desc: Pick any extra entities (smart appliances, custom sensors, etc.) to show as tiles at the bottom of the Security view. Useful for ovens, cooktops, irons — anything you want a glance at before leaving the house.
editor.show_camera_view_desc: Under active development, details may still change. Generates a dedicated camera view: live picture, spotlight, PTZ controls and recordings link (Reolink) per camera.
editor.show_camera_events_desc: Person/animal/vehicle timelines at the end of the camera view (requires LLM Vision + llmvision-card). Note: the card re-fetches its events on every state change — on busy systems this can create noticeable load.
editor.unavailable_batteries_critical: Show as critical (alerts you to broken sensors)
editor.show_window_alerts_on_areas: Show open window/door icons on area cards
editor.show_window_alerts_on_areas_desc: Shows an alert icon on the area card whenever a window, door, opening, or garage-door contact sensor in that area is open. Independent of the regular alert toggle above.
editor.show_cameras_in_rooms_desc: Shows cameras assigned to the area in the respective room views. Disable to keep cameras out of the dashboard without hiding them globally.
editor.hide_unavailable_in_rooms: Hide unavailable entities in room views
editor.hide_unavailable_in_rooms_desc: Skips entities whose state is `unavailable` (offline integrations, dead batteries, disconnected ESPHome devices) when building room views. Default on — these entities show up elsewhere (Batteries view, the optional Unavailable alert badge) and tend to be noise in a room view. Disable to surface them in the room view too.
editor.custom_sections_desc: Declare your own overview section blocks — just copy the complete section code (type: grid + cards) from any dashboard and paste it. Heading (heading card) and visibility are controlled directly in the YAML. The section key works in Section Order, as a target section for custom cards and in visibility rules.
editor.custom_section_yaml_placeholder:
type: grid
cards:
  - type: heading
    heading: Good morning
  - type: markdown
    content: "Coffee is ready!"
editor.custom_section_key_required: Key missing — the section will not be rendered
editor.custom_section_key_conflict: Key collides with a built-in section
editor.custom_section_key_duplicate: Key is already used by another custom section
editor.area_custom_sections_desc: Your own section blocks for this room view — paste complete section code (heading card inside the YAML, optional; visibility via visibility), placed above or below the auto-generated sections. Single cards are wrapped into a section automatically.
editor.view_visibility_desc: Choose which users can see each view tab. Without a restriction the view is visible to everyone. This is display logic only, not access control.
editor.view_visibility_no_users: No persons linked to an HA user found — rules can alternatively be set through the view_visible_users YAML key.
editor.view_visibility_warning: Important: Only the tab in the header and the entry points on the overview (summary tiles, area cards) are hidden. The view stays reachable via its URL — this is not real access control.
editor.view_visibility_no_person_warning: User accounts without a linked person cannot be selected here. Once a view or section has a visibility rule, those accounts will no longer see it — without a rule they continue to see everything. Fix: assign a person to the user under Settings → People.
editor.view_visibility_reload_hint: After changing rules, reload the browser page/tab so they take effect everywhere.
editor.view_visibility_sections_desc: Choose per overview section which users can see it (e.g. weather, energy or your custom sections).
editor.room_pins_first: Show pins at the top of the room (instead of at the end)
editor.domain_cameras_disabled_hint: Disabled globally — enable “Show cameras in room views” first.
editor.domain_group_disabled_hint: Globally disabled — enable the toggle in the room settings above.
editor.show_maintenance_summary_desc: Adds a “Maintenance” tile with its own subview (/maintenance): pending updates, unavailable devices, critical batteries and HA repairs (HA 2026.3+, admins only).
editor.maintenance_visible_users_desc: Without a selection every user sees the tile and tab. Options come from persons linked to an HA user. Note: display logic only, not access control — the view stays reachable by URL.
editor.maintenance_visible_users_none: No persons linked to an HA user found — restrict via the maintenance_visible_users YAML key instead.
editor.show_video_tips_desc: Shows up to three matching Dashboard Strategy videos (German language) for your installed integrations in the maintenance view. Static list shipped with the bundle — nothing is fetched or transmitted. Each tip can be dismissed permanently per browser.
editor.show_maintenance_activity_desc: Logbook of the last 24 hours in the sidebar — scoped to the entities this view currently reports (pending updates, unavailable devices, critical batteries). Auto-hides without the logbook integration or when nothing is reported.
editor.design_desc: Theme and background image for all views of the dashboard. Custom views that set their own theme/background in YAML keep their setting.
editor.design_bg_image_hint: Pick an image via the media dialog or upload one directly. Alternatively via YAML: background.image also accepts a path/URL (e.g. /local/background.jpg); size/alignment via further background keys.

custom_views.ref_error_title: Referenced view could not be loaded
custom_views.ref_error_dashboard: The source dashboard is missing or could not be loaded. Check the reference in the editor.
custom_views.ref_error_strategy: The source dashboard is generated by a strategy and cannot be referenced.
custom_views.ref_error_view: The referenced view no longer exists in the source dashboard. Check the reference in the editor.

cctv.no_cameras: No cameras found. Cameras appear here automatically once they are set up in Home Assistant.

maintenance.hacs_hint: HACS is installed — community updates show up in the updates list above.
